summary: Prerequisites for the Ansible plug-ins: RHDH installed on OpenShift (Helm or Operator), a valid AAP subscription, permission to create applications in the project, RHDH able to query the automation controller API, and optionally outbound access to developers.redhat.com for learning paths.
questions: What are the prerequisites for Ansible plug-ins for RHDH?
Does RHDH need access to the automation controller API?
Why do learning paths need developers.redhat.com?
